column1: # key_period.tsv -- F61-FAMILY, 28 Sept 2026. Key source: period (CLAUDE.md rule 4 / rule 10 key-source vocabulary): every
# (class, letter) pair is read from a contemporary interlinear decipherment written on the leaf itself, aligned to the
# atlas-coded cipher signs by tools/interlinear_align.py (--code-prefix @ --null-cost -1 --clear-consumes), grade C for the
# pair, no cryptanalysis and no refit. Classes are the f.61 shape atlas (scripts/f61_atlas.tsv) plus H24 (see KEY.md).
# '-' = the sign took no letter in the alignment (a null or an abbreviation in the gloss). n = occurrences; bands = which
# line bands of that leaf. Tomokiyo's mayenne.png reconstruction is a separate, published key and is not used here.
